description: Register a job with the scheduler service: run a predicate command on an interval or a cron schedule and run an action command when it reports a message; terminates on success.

predicate.description: The predicate command string to run each tick, e.g. "ibkr-cli query LITE le 810". By contract it prints one JSON object {"status":"true|false|error","message":"..."} to stdout; set noContract for a plain command judged by exit code instead.

action.description: The action command string run when the predicate emits a non-empty message. MUST contain the literal token {{message}}, which the scheduler replaces with the message as a single argv element. e.g. "discord-notify --text {{message}} --channel 123456789012345678".

every.description: Poll interval as a Go duration, e.g. 1s, 30s, 15m, 1h. Exactly one cadence: supply every OR cron+tz, never both.

cron.description: A standard 5-field cron expression for a time-of-day cadence, e.g. "30 7 * * 1-5" (weekdays 07:30). Requires tz; mutually exclusive with every.

tz.description: IANA time zone the cron expression is evaluated in, e.g. "Europe/London" or "America/New_York". Required with cron.

maxRuns.description: Max predicate runs before the job expires. Omit for unlimited (-1).

maxDuration.description: Max wall-clock window before expiry, as a duration (e.g. 24h). A cron job expires at the boundary without a final fire. Omit for unlimited.

noContract.description: Treat the predicate as contract-free: exit 0 -> true, non-zero -> error, stdout -> message. Use for plain commands that do not emit the JSON envelope.
